messages.subject: part4 row order
parts:
Hi Vincent and GGIR team,

I have accelerometer data in R Studio (GGIR), and I am extracting data across part2, 4 and 5 outputs. When extracting the relevant data from each of these files, I noticed part 2 and 5 files ordered participants (rows) in the same order, however part4 jumbled up the order of the participants (rows). Is there a reason for this, and is there a way I can create the part 4 output file in the same order as the part 2/5 files? 

Many thanks for your advice in advance. 

Gareth
Sheffield Hallam University

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] part4 row order
parts:
Thanks for reporting this Gareth, this is currently being fixed and will be part of the next release which we hope to put on CRAN in the upcoming weeks.

Night number was stored as a string and then ordered alphabetically by which we get order of 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, etc. The values of each row are correct (night 1 corresponds to the estimates for night 1), so it is only the row order that is somewhat non-intuitive at the moment.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] part4 row order
parts:
Updates to GGIR only happen to new releases. Past GGIR releases will always remain unchanged to provide a clear track record of how GGIR has changed and to support reproducibility. So, if there was a bug in an old release then that bug will be there forever. This is how software versioning works in general.

Thanks,

Vincent
